Hi Karthik,

We’re moving forward with the renewal and an additional 250 GPU-hours for Q4. Purchasing asked me to confirm two things before we submit the formal PO:

- Our procurement team needs to know whether the invoice will be a single line item to be routed to our central finance mailbox, or if Redwood can split the invoice so the upgrade portion is billed to a different internal cost center.
- We have a strict policy against one-off surcharges; if there are any usage-based surcharge items tied to burst capacity or data egress, we need them to be waived or captured in the quote line items.

I’ll have the PO ready by Monday. Our preferred terms are Net60 and we’ll attach the PO number in the PDF. Please also confirm any outstanding vendor documentation (W-9, tax ID) your team requires.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

—Lena

- We can support a split invoice (billing allocation) for the renewal vs. the capacity add; we’ll need the cost-center codes you want on each line and the PO to reflect two invoice recipients (primary billing + project charge).
- Regarding surcharges: we do not typically apply an unspecified surcharge for burst usage on renewals. For this renewal I can raise a formal request for a surcharge waiver/credit for StormForge as long as the PO reflects the committed capacity levels. I’ll need finance approval for the waiver.

Action items I’ll take:
1) Loop in Marissa (Finance) and Naomi (Billing ops) — cc’d — to confirm the W-9/tax-id and acceptance workflow.
2) Draft a short amendment that enumerates the split invoicing lines and requests the surcharge waiver; I’ll send that for your review before we sign.

If you can send the PO to billing@stormforge.com (cc me) that’ll speed things up.

Cheers,

Karthik / Naomi — tagging in. Quick finance checklist for PO acceptance: 

1) Entity match: PO lists "StormForge, Inc." but the W-9 we have on file uses the parent name "StormForge Holdings" — we need a vendor W-9 that matches the legal entity on the PO or a sub-contracting addendum.
2) Net terms: Net60 is fine; we’ll add acceptance in our contract amendment. If invoices are split across GL codes and routed to two recipients, each invoice must include the PO line number and the cost-center for routing automation.
3) Surcharge waiver: we can approve a one-time waiver for the standard burst surcharge for this renewal provided: (a) the PO includes the committed capacity hours, (b) there’s a signed amendment that references the waiver, and (c) we log the waiver in the deal record (HubSpot).
4) Required docs from Redwood to StormForge: signed amendment PDF, Redwood W-9 (up-to-date), and the DocuSign envelope or countersign link.

Lena — please ask procurement to send a W-9 that exactly matches the PO legal name. Once we have that we can countersign and route invoices as requested. I’ll prepare the amendment and estimate the timing (48h after W-9).

—Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
